scope_note: The official stenographic report of the Fifth (extraordinary) Congress of People's Deputies of the RSFSR, volume I, as an image-only scan of two-page spreads. The ninth (evening) sitting of 15 July 1991 (contents, PDF p. 368; printed pp. 310-311 on PDF p. 156) was read. The volume has no text layer; it was searched with a word spotter and the hits read from the page images. Speeches for the RSFSR deputies' group or faction «Демократическая Россия» in this volume are a separate identity and are not imported. The scan is hosted by the non-official ISTNET / RSFSR-RF.RU project; the recorded identity is a raw Internet Archive capture made before the cutoff.

rows.role_title: Сопредседатель движения «Демократическая Россия» (Координационного совета) — Co-chair of the Democratic Russia movement
rows.text: At the ninth (evening) sitting of the Fifth (extraordinary) Congress of People's Deputies of the RSFSR (15 July 1991) the presiding officer gives the floor to 'координатор фракции беспартийных Юрий Николаевич Афанасьев'; 'Афанасьев Ю.Н., Первомайский территориальный избирательный округ, г. Москва' answers 'я не координатор беспартийных. Здесь, видимо, ошибка' and ends: 'В случае, если это предложение будет отвергнуто, я как сопредседатель движения ”Демократическая Россия” обращаюсь к гражданам России с призывом развернуть широкую кампанию по отзыву всех без исключения депутатов, входящих в эти фракции.'
rows.locator: Ninth sitting: contents, PDF p. 368 ("Повторное выдвижение кандидатур ... 310"); speech, printed pp. 310-311 (PDF p. 156)

bounded_scope: Democratic Russia movement and Soyuz deputies' group observations for CLAUDE-C01-35 only. Founding, selection or election, statements, nominations, registration, leadership references by other deputies, membership statements and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Co-chairs are recorded as co-leadership, one person per holder observation. State offices, the CPSU, russia.json and the simulation's party rows are outside this extract.
